INUME2.desc: Numerical flag for TE and TI

IPROT.desc: Numerical flag for poloidal terms in parallel momentum transport: < 1  - do not add poloidal rotation corrections to equation. >= 1 - add correction terms. If -2 or 2 : use suzpei in getpei equipartiton for implicit scheme. If -3 or 3: add centrifugal force from VTOR to equilibrium. Note that VTOR in this case is explicitly the LFS VTOR (so that Omega = VTOR/(RLFS_local). If -4 or 4, use both suzpei and rotation in equilibrium.

ITFBP.desc: if 0, nothing. If 1, uses PSIFB as bc for PSI equation.

ICIRCQ.desc: if 0, nothing. If 1, does circuit equations

IPCTRL.desc: if 0, nothing. If 1, uses controller for external coils

IFBEY.desc: switched to = 1 if doing fbe, to 0 if doing PBE
